documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q4 FY26 and full year FY26, driven by festive demand and occasion wear. Revenue from operations for the quarter stood at INR 190 crores with a 38% year-on-year growth, while full year revenue reached INR 637 crores. Management highlighted ongoing retail expansion plans in Gujarat, including new stores in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Eastern Ahmedabad slated for the current fiscal year. The company remains focused on its core antique gold bridal jewellery segment while monitoring recent macroeconomic developments and industry regulations. RBZ Jewellers Limited released its Earnings Presentation for Q4 FY26 and FY26, reporting operational revenue of INR 6,365 Mn and PAT of INR 548 Mn for the full year.

guidance.claim: Management projected the annual revenue guidance to be around INR600 crores to INR650 crores for the full year.
guidance.quote: Guidance for this quarter is to meet the yearly target that we have set for the full year, that would be somewhere around INR50 crores to INR55 crores of PAT and INR600 crores to INR650 crores of annual revenue.

guidance.claim: Management provided an expected revenue of INR800 crores to INR900 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Should be probably doing around INR800 crores, INR900 crores with a PAT of around INR55 crores, INR60 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the Surat retail store to generate a revenue of around INR150 crores.
guidance.quote: So, one will be in Surat, we are expecting a revenue of around INR150 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the upcoming wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted steady consumer demand ahead of the upcoming wedding season in the Occasional Wear segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Witnessing steady consumer demand ahead of the upcoming wedding season in the Occasional Wear segment, supported by ongoing optimisation of inventory mix with lightweight and budget-friendly offerings.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they are witnessing steady consumer demand in the Occasion Wear segment.
demand_outlook.quote: We are witnessing steady consumer demand in the Occasion Wear segment, supported by ongoing optimization of our inventory mix with a sharper focus on lightweight, that is look to weight ratio, and budget-friendly offerings.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that retail revenue stood at INR155 crores with a strong growth of 39% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR155 crores, registering a strong growth of 39% y-on-y.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities like Gandhinagar for mid-sized showrooms of approximately 5,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar, for mid-sized showrooms (~5,000 sq. ft. carpet area), for future expansion to leverage the company’s established brand positioning and further strengthen regional presence and drive incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management identified strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad for mid-sized stores of approximately 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we also have identified strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad for mid-sized stores of approximately 5,000 square feet, reinforcing our regional footprint and supporting incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the Surat store will be 10,000 square feet and the Rajkot store will be 12,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: So Deepesh Bhai, the two flagship stores of 10,000 square feet in Surat and 12,000 square feet in Rajkot, we are planning to open in the quarter 2 of this year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the full financial year improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA for the quarter increased to INR30 crores, reflecting a growth of 36% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter increased to INR30 crores reflecting a growth of 36% Y-on-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margin expanded by 184 basis points year-on-year to 13.04%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 184 basis points Y-on-Y to 13.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that profit after tax stood at INR17 crores, growing at 33% with PAT margins improving to 7.69%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR17 crores going at 33% with PAT margins improving to 7.69%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects a marketing spend of around INR25 crores for next year.
margins_costs.quote: Marketing spend around INR25 crores is expected.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company launched approximately 951 new designs during the quarter, averaging 12 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched approximately 951 new designs, averaging 12 designs per day, primarily in the Occasion Wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that the job work volume for Q3 was around 96 to 97 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: The volume of job work is 96 kgs -- 96 kgs, 97 kgs.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the current bank limit utilization is around INR110 crores to INR115 crores out of a INR255 crores sanction.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now, the utilization of bank is around INR110 crores, INR115 crores. INR255 crores sanction is in our hand.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that wholesale revenue declined by 12% year-on-year to INR70 crores for the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Wholesale revenue stood at INR70 crores, which has seen a decline of 12% Y-on-Y, while job work revenue approximately to INR2 crores, declining 46% Y-o-Y.

management_commitments.claim: Both the showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Both showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are planned to commence operations in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: with both the showrooms planned to commence operations in Q2 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company is set to commence certain products in-house in the Daily Wear segment from Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: further the company is set to commence certain products in-house in Daily Wear segment from Q1 FY27 with dedicated infrastructure in place.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that dedicated infrastructure is in place to commence certain products in-house in the Daily Wear segment from Q1 of fiscal '27.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are set to commence certain products in-house in Daily Wear segment from quarter 1 of fiscal '27 with dedicated infrastructure in place.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
